outbound.why: the local canonical store. Section 6's inner ring is records/, which reaches nothing; store/ is the declared exception and this is the one module in the tree that opens a connection. Declared by module rather than by host:port because the DSN is resolved from the environment at run time - a store carrying its own address in the tree connects to whatever is running.

write_paths.why: the store, and the only thing in this application that writes. Drafts in, sealed rows never rewritten, disclosure entries in the same transaction as the reads they narrate. Gate G-C: this line and tools/manifest.py's reconciliation landed in the same commit as the package.
renders templates to tracked artifacts under presentation/rendered/. Its own --check mode is the template/rendered pair's named middle and runs in CI.

writes one dated, commit-pinned conformance record per --write run, with open("x") so a record is never overwritten. Invisible to this check until 2026-07-31, when purity.py's mode reader was found to be looking at the wrong argument for the pathlib spelling.

temporary trees, fixture files, and tests/ablate.py, which edits the working tree on purpose and restores it three ways. Development machinery rather than application code, and declared rather than excused so that a write appearing here still has to be one somebody wrote.
